basics.name: Juk-Sen Tang
basics.label: Undergraduate Researcher in Agricultural Economics
basics.summary: Undergraduate student at McGill University pursuing a B.Sc. in Agricultural Economics with a minor in Computer Science. Research interests span agricultural economics, environmental and resource economics, and applied econometrics. Published in Agriculture on agricultural productivity and spatial spillover effects, with working papers on carbon pricing and green innovation, causal machine learning for policy evaluation, urban scaling laws, and food safety classification.

work.name: Key Lab of Urban Agriculture (North China), Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs, Beijing Academy of Agricultural and Forestry Sciences
work.summary: Contributing to research on agricultural productivity and policy analysis for North China urban agriculture.
highlights: Drafted policy briefs for the PRC 15th Five-Year Agricultural Plan, focusing on regional economic coordination and benchmarking Canada's agricultural science and technology innovation systems to inform domestic policy

Built spatial econometric datasets and analysed TFP-based coordination patterns across Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, identifying technology spillover, efficiency drag, and scale synergy channels to inform regional integration policy

work.name: International Education College, NUAA
highlights: Coordinate bilingual outreach, interview logistics, and enrollment reporting for international student recruitment

publications.summary: Authors: TANG Juk-Sen (Lead), ZHANG Haobo, SHAN Lily, CHEN Junhong. Applied Causal Forest with DML to three policy reforms across 2,700+ Chinese counties.

publications.summary: Author: TANG Juk-Sen (Sole Author). Estimated sector-specific urban scaling exponents for approximately 2,800 Chinese counties (2000–2023).
